title: Malone's Pool Tournament
headline: Pool Tournament at Malone's Pub
intro: Sign up, check the house rules, and report match results for the Malone's Pub pool tournament in Downtown Fort Worth.
details: Hosted at Malone's Pub, 1303 Calhoun St in Downtown Fort Worth.
Bracket format, match length, and start time can be posted here once confirmed.
Players should check in with the bartender or tournament organizer before their first match.
rules: Tournament games are played on the house pool table using house equipment unless the organizer approves otherwise.
Standard 8-ball rules apply unless a house rule is posted before the bracket starts.
Lag or coin flip determines the opening break.
Call the 8-ball pocket before shooting the 8-ball.
If a shot or foul is disputed, pause the game and ask the tournament organizer before the next shot.
The winner reports the final result after the match.
Good sportsmanship is expected. The organizer has final say on rule calls, forfeits, and bracket issues.
